_doc: The look of every illustration. gen.py builds each prompt as: lead (character | style_only) + shot prompt + ink + kinds[kind] + never.
character: Use the mascot in the attached image as the character reference: keep him exactly the same character, with the same round face, round glasses, neat side parting, hair colour, slim grey suit, white shirt, skinny navy tie, short-brimmed grey hat with a navy band, proportions and ink style, instantly recognisable; never redesign him. Use only the character from the reference, not its layout or its text.
style_only: Match the drawing style of the attached image exactly: the same thick ink lines, flat cream, navy and golden-yellow palette and halftone shading. Take only the drawing style from it: not its character, not its paper sheet, worn edges or layout.
ink: Mid-century cartoon style: thick confident black ink outlines, flat limited palette of cream, navy blue and golden yellow with occasional signal red accents, halftone dot shading, a subtle aged-paper grain across the whole picture. The world is 1950s retro-futurism, the future as imagined in 1957: atomic-age optimism, googie architecture, chrome, boomerang and starburst shapes, rockets, monorails, flying cars and friendly robots.

kinds.film: A wide 21:9 full-bleed illustration that fills the entire image edge to edge, right up to all four edges: no paper sheet, no worn or torn paper edges, no rounded corners, no card border, no frame, no vignette. Keep heads, hats and key objects well inside the frame with breathing room above and below.
kinds.sheet: Laid out as a clean animation model sheet on cream paper.
kinds.scene: A full-bleed illustration that fills the entire image edge to edge: no border, no frame.
kinds.ref: A single full-body character portrait, front three-quarter view, standing, on plain cream paper.

never: No text, no letters, no numbers anywhere in the image, no signs with writing, no watermark, no real people, no logos. Nothing post-apocalyptic: no bomb shelters, no gas masks, no ruins, no mushroom clouds, no radiation symbols.
